rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies an expanded blastocyst with thinned zona, visible blastocoel, left-sided ICM, and cohesive TE; appropriately notes limits of single-image assessment. Minor overcalling of exact AA quality from the image alone.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, PCOS, BMI, prior failed cycles, semen quality, day of development, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis adjusted for prior failures and PCOS. Slight uncertainty around exact implantation/live birth estimates keeps it from perfect.

Recommendations are well aligned with standard IVF practice: SET for a young patient with a good-quality blastocyst, caution about fresh transfer in PCOS, attention to luteal support and uterine evaluation, and avoidance of low-evidence add-ons.

Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, review of cycle conditions, uterine cavity assessment, metabolic optimization, and when to consider FET or PGT-A discussion.
